name: Iron Eon
look: a jet-shaped violet-blue Latios with navy bands, a cyan canopy, swept white-tipped delta wings, engine pods, three tall fins in glowing cyan afterburn and long hooked horns at its nose
entry: It flies at speeds almost too fast for the eye to follow, and the sonic boom of its passing clears the clouds from the sky. A report about it says its body makes all the energy it needs.
how: Wild: very rare by day on mountains and peaks.
